description:
Question. TPC-DS 4.0.0 clause 5.2.3 requires each maintenance function's refresh data set to be generated with dsdgen (dsdgen execution is not timed). Clauses 5.2.5 and 5.2.7 make loading the refresh data, including into a staging area, a timed part of the maintenance run, through generic or vendor loaders (a TPC-DS-specific loader is prohibited). Clause 5.3 defines 11 maintenance functions: seven LF_* functions (Method 1: insert from a view over the staged refresh tables) and four DF_* functions (Methods 2 and 3: delete by date range); there are no UPDATE functions, and 5.1.3 lets functions be combined into any number of database operations. BenchBox's maintenance operations (benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_operations.py and maintenance_test.py) instead generate synthetic rows in Python with random values and run per-row UPDATE handlers (_update_customer, _update_item, _update_inventory, _bulk_update_inventory) that the spec does not define.

Timer defects that do not depend on the answer (connection setup and initialize() inside each interval, time.time() durations, a time-seeded generator) are fixed by tpcds-maintenance-timer-hygiene-20261103, which waits on no decision.

Options.
A. Use dsdgen refresh sets (-update): generate outside the timer, load through the platform's generic loader inside the timer, implement the 11 functions as set-based SQL over the 5.3.11 views. Consequences: a new maintenance method, so maintenance timings are not comparable with earlier BenchBox results and results must carry a maintenance method identifier; the UPDATE handlers are deleted, so perf-tpcds-maintenance-set-based-20261031 is superseded by tpcds-maintenance-dsdgen-refresh-data-20261103 (close it as superseded with that reason); tpcds-qphds-spec-metric-implementation keeps its need on the dsdgen item. Recommended.
B. Keep the synthetic generator and mark maintenance non-official in result metadata. Consequences: no official QphDS export; tpcds-qphds-spec-metric-implementation is dropped or re-scoped; tpcds-maintenance-dsdgen-refresh-data-20261103 is dropped; perf-tpcds-maintenance-set-based-20261031 stays and waits only on the hygiene item.
C. Dual path: dsdgen refresh for official runs, synthetic behind an explicit non-official flag. Consequences: two code paths to maintain; the set-based item applies to the synthetic path only.

Sub-question (recommended answer: compare and rank within one maintenance method only, refuse rather than warn, mirroring the timing-method rule in the locality ADR): how does comparison treat results of different maintenance methods?

Evidence to prepare (agent, read-only): confirm the bundled dsdgen supports -update and what files it emits, and the refresh-set size at SF1; map the 11 spec functions to the current handlers; list published or retained results that contain maintenance timings and which QphDS metric inputs consume them (benchbox/core/results/metrics.py; no symbol named T_DM exists there, so find the actual names); re-read 5.2.3, 5.2.5, 5.2.7, 5.3 and 7.4.9.1.

Decision gate. Only the owner decides; the agent prepares the brief and then updates dependents.

Guardrails: read-only until the decision is recorded; no changes to other items except the dependents named in the acceptance.
